modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunkstorageo: Lets Chunk Storage Optimizer worlds keep their .cso format with C2ME installed.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkstor: C2ME's chunk IO rewrite would read the .mca files straight past Chunk Storage Optimizer, and a converted world would have its terrain silently regenerated. This compat bridges the two per world: worlds the storage mod serves keep the vanilla IO worker, worlds on plain Anvil keep C2ME's rewrite. Does nothing without C2ME.
